card.name: Time units after a number
card.fires_on: Units of time such as hours, minutes, seconds or months directly after a number in dosing or imaging schedules. It also fires weakly on a few other tokens after numbers.

modes.label: Time unit after number
modes.description: A time word follows a numeral giving a duration or interval.

modes.label: Dosing interval
modes.description: The unit follows a number in a schedule of repeated doses.
modes.example: The recommended dosage is 100 mg administered once every 6<< months>> by subcutaneous injection
